description: PREFER THIS for 'turn this long video/podcast into shorts/clips'. engine highlights (default): transcribes (or reuses transcriptionJobId/subtitles), an LLM picks the count (default 3, max 10) best self-contained moments of minSeconds-maxSeconds, renders each MP4 (reframe face, center or none) with captions, and returns clips with title, hook, score and url. Price: 1 credit per source minute to transcribe (0 with a transcript) + 1 per 10 source minutes + 3 per output minute; quoteOnly:true prices it free. engine shorts: quick 1-5 vertical 9:16 cuts from an existing transcript, 6 credits per source minute. Long jobs: poll get_job.

anyOf.description: Default true. Same rule as caption_video.

Default true: caption size, words per caption (4 on 9:16, 5 on 1:1, 7 on 16:9), and a default safe zone follow the video shape, so text reads the same at 720p and 1080p and stays clear of app UI. Pass false only when the user wants the preset's exact fixed pixel sizes. Same price.

autoFit.description: Default true. Same rule as caption_video.

brandPresetId.description: Id from manage_preset {action:'create', type:'brand'}: applies its font, color, position and logo on top of the preset.

captions.description: Burn captions into each clip. Default true. Same price.

anyOf.description: Clips to return, 1-10. Default 3. Out of range: 422 limit_exceeded before any charge.
1-5 clips. Out of range returns limit_exceeded before any charge.

count.description: Clips to return, 1-10. Default 3. Out of range: 422 limit_exceeded before any charge.

durationSeconds.description: Media length in seconds. Lets the price be computed without fetching media (quoteOnly, quote, plan).

engine.description: highlights (default): LLM-ranked best moments, up to 10, any shape, transcribes if needed. shorts: quick 1-5 vertical 9:16 cuts when you already have the transcript (6 credits per source minute).

faceAvoid.description: true = move captions off faces (samples faces at 2 fps, same price; result.faceAvoid.faceLayout). Shortcut for styleOverrides.faceAvoid.

anyOf.description: Id from upload {action:'start'}, import_url, or upload {action:'inline'}.
Id of a file already uploaded with upload {action:'start'}, upload {action:'start_multipart'}, upload {action:'inline'} or import_url. Pass this or the media URL.

fileId.description: Id from upload {action:'start'}, import_url, or upload {action:'inline'}.

glossary.description: Extra terms to spell correctly in this job only (brand names, people). The saved glossary (update_glossary {action:'save'}) is applied as well.

highlightWords.description: Shortcut: words or phrases to color in every caption (accent/case-insensitive), e.g. ["AwesomeVideo", "gratis"]. Maps to styleOverrides.wordHighlights rule {id:"custom", words, color}. Same price.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own unique key for this request (max 200 chars). Retrying with the same key returns the first job instead of charging again.

anyOf.description: Refuse the job if it would cost more than this many credits.
Spending cap for this call in credits (1 credit = 1 cent). If the price is higher the call fails with 422 before charging.

maxCredits.description: Refuse the job if it would cost more than this many credits.

anyOf.description: Longest clip, minSeconds-90 s. Default 60.
Longest clip, minSeconds-60 seconds.

mediaUrl.description: Public https link to the video or audio (direct file, chat attachment URL, Google Drive or Dropbox share link; YouTube is refused). Pass this or fileId.

anyOf.description: Shortest clip, 5-90 s. Default 15.
Shortest clip, 5-60 seconds. Default 15.

notifyEmail.description: Email address that gets a link when the job finishes or fails.

anyOf.description: tiktok, instagram_reels, youtube_shorts, ... (see get_catalog {kind:'platforms'}). Keeps captions clear of the app UI. Same price.

Where the video will be posted: tiktok, instagram_reels, youtube_shorts, facebook_reels, snapchat_spotlight, linkedin, youtube, x (aliases like reels, instagram, shorts, snap, twitter; case-insensitive). Keeps captions out of that app's buttons and text. If the user says "para TikTok" / "for Reels", pass it; if they did not say and it matters, ask. Same price. Unknown values return 422 invalid_platform before any charge. See get_catalog {kind:'platforms'}.

platform.description: tiktok, instagram_reels, youtube_shorts, ... (see get_catalog {kind:'platforms'}). Keeps captions clear of the app UI. Same price.

anyOf.description: Caption preset id or name, or custom:cp_.... Default Clarity.
Caption preset: id, slug or name from get_catalog {kind:'presets'} (e.g. 'hormozi-style', 'Clarity') or custom:cp_... from manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'}.

preset.description: Caption preset id or name, or custom:cp_.... Default Clarity.

quoteOnly.description: Return the price for durationSeconds (and count/maxSeconds) without starting a job.

anyOf.description: face (default): 9:16 crop that follows the speaker, center fallback. center: plain center crop. none: keep the source aspect. Same price.
face (default): track the main speaker. center: plain center crop. Same price.

reframe.description: face (default): 9:16 crop that follows the speaker, center fallback. center: plain center crop. none: keep the source aspect. Same price.

sourceUrl.description: Public link to the video. Not YouTube, TikTok or Instagram.

styleOverrides.description: Per-call style changes deep-merged onto the preset (same fields as get_catalog {kind:'presets'} style; null removes a field), validated with the renderer schema and bundled fonts. Example {"fontSize":72,"maxWordsPerCaption":2,"wordEntrance":"bounce"}. Same price. No need to manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'}. Every field with examples: get_catalog {kind:'styles'}.

anyOf.description: Reuse an SRT, VTT, or JSON transcript (JSON keeps word timing for tighter cuts).
Existing captions as SRT, WebVTT or AwesomeVideo JSON text. Skips transcription (no transcription charge).

subtitles.description: Reuse an SRT, VTT, or JSON transcript (JSON keeps word timing for tighter cuts).

anyOf.description: Reuse a finished transcription: no transcription charge.
Id of a finished transcribe or caption_video job whose transcript to reuse (no new transcription charge).

transcriptionJobId.description: Reuse a finished transcription: no transcription charge.

wait.description: Block until done, up to waitSeconds. Default true.

webhookUrl.description: https URL that receives a POST with the finished job (status, result URLs, credits charged).

name: create_clips

outputSchema.description: A job: poll get_job with id until status is succeeded or failed.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed.

expiresAt.description: When the result files are deleted.

id.description: Job id: pass it to get_job, resume_job, edit_transcript or as transcriptionJobId.

kind.description: Job kind (transcribe, burn, caption, clips, shorts, trim, dub, translate, preview, metadata...).

result.description: Result when succeeded: url, files[{name, url}], clips, text...

title: Long video to short clips
